<div class="drug-info-card">
<strong>Drug Information</strong>
<ul>
<li><strong>Original indication</strong>: Nulojix, in combination with corticosteroids and a mycophenolic acid (MPA), is indicated for prophylaxis of graft rejection in adult&nbsp;recipients of a renal transplant.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Evidence level</strong>: L5</li>
<li><strong>Predicted indications (20)</strong>:<ul>
<li>plasma cell myeloma (97.0%)</li>

<li>colonic neoplasm (93.6%)</li>

<li>orofacial clefting syndrome (93.5%)</li>
<li>disorder of fucoglycosan synthesis (93.4%)</li>
